# Trustworthy AI For Healthcare, Run By People Who Used To Insure It

We enable pharmaceutical companies to navigate the complexities of AI with confidence. Our platform provides clear, safe, and actionable insights into how AI models perceive and communicate about healthcare topics, streamlining compliance and enhancing your engagement strategy.

> "Our Mission is to make AI answers in healthcare clear, safe, and actionable. We empower patient, healthcare professional, and organizations with trustworthy guidance, enabling confident decision making."

## Our Story: From AI Risk Assessment to Pharma Clarity

Our roots are in the AI risk team at Munich Re, the world's largest re-insurer, where we evaluated and certified high-stakes AI systems for regulated industries. This foundation gives us a unique perspective, combining proven risk management expertise—understanding compliance, security, and validation deeply—with deep technical expertise in AI engineering, benchmarking, and managing model intricacies like drift and bias. We built ceel.ai to bring this blend of rigor and innovation to healthcare, offering AI insights grounded in trust and transparency.

## Our Team

### Dr. Daniel Weimer

* Former CTO @ Munich Re's Trustworthy AI Venture
* Former Head of AI @ Volkswagen Group of America
* PhD in Computer Vision (e.g. Technion Israel)

### Andreas Gensch

* Serial Entrepreneur with proven track record
* Scaled & Exited 2 FinTechs in the Analytics space
* Background in Strategy Consulting & Economics (MSc)

### Dr. Patrick Markt-Niederreiter

* 16+ years Pharma leadership (e.g., VP @ Daiichi Sankyo)
* Pioneered first-in-company & first-in-pharma AI solutions
* Recognized Thought Leader & former EFPIA Board member

## Our Core Value: Trust Through Transparency

For us, trust isn't just a goal; it's our foundation. We believe the only way to navigate the new world of AI in healthcare is by providing our partners with a clear, unfiltered, and honest view. No black boxes, just actionable clarity. This principle guides how we operate:

1

### Patient & HCP Centricity

We design for clarity and safety first. By incorporating human validation via patient insights, we ensure outputs are reliable, relevant, and truly serve user needs

2

### Fairness & Transparency

We operate openly – in our interactions and our pricing. Clear, value-driven engagement models mean no surprises, fostering genuine partnership

3

### Efficiency Through Integration

We meet you where you work. By embedding insights directly into your existing workflows and tools, we enable faster action without disruption to how you operate

"Trust is human. AI helps scale it."

— The ceel.ai Team

## Win Where Healthcare Decisions Begin.

Ready to turn insights into measurable impact? See the platform in action and discover what's truly possible.
